name: no-cluster
description: The /cluster bootstrap is the identity namespace and the integration documents that it aborts without it. Prism rejects the credential on that first call; the run must stop there, report the credential problem, and never fetch hosts or VMs -- because any asset it emitted would carry an unscoped id that collides with the same estate imported through another Controller VM.  The task now ENDS IN ERROR rather than reporting a successful run with zero assets: a refused credential and an empty tenant are otherwise the same result, and only the exit status separates them.

default_response.text: no request should reach this fixture after the cluster call fails

error_contains: authentication rejected, check the username and password
